blocks.caption: Acceptance check 1: npm run lint on the clean tree exits 0 with no output, so the new rule finds no existing violation

Acceptance check 2: inline (amountCents / 100).toFixed(2) on app/invoices/page.tsx line 27 gives two no-restricted-syntax errors, and the message names formatAmount and formatCurrency (the tree was reverted afterwards)
Acceptance check 3: new Intl.NumberFormat inside components/ExportButton.tsx gives a no-restricted-syntax error on line 11 and a non-zero exit (the edit was reverted afterwards)
Acceptance check 4: the same (c / 100).toFixed(2) appended to lib/invoices.ts still lints with exit 0, because lib/ is out of the rule's scope (the edit was reverted afterwards)
Acceptance check 5: npm test exits 0, 5 files and 32 tests pass, and lint-rules.test.ts reports 4 of 4 passing
Acceptance check 6: /invoices in Chromium after next build and next start shows the five invoices, the amounts 245.00 and 1180.00, 'Total sent: $1,497.50', and the button 'Export 3 invoices as CSV'
Acceptance check 6: accessibility snapshot of the same page, listing every table row and the total paragraph as text
Acceptance check 6 (regression probe): GET /invoices/export returns 200 text/csv with the header row and the three sent or paid rows, INV-1004 (draft) and INV-1005 (void) absent
Acceptance check 6: server-rendered HTML of /invoices, the raw response for the five invoices and the export button label
